Vocabulary Booster.question: ১) The word 'Subside' means -
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Subside (verb intransitive)

English Meaning: (of a condition) To become less strong, or (of an activity or disagreement) to become less violent.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) (বন্যার পানি) হ্রাস পাওয়া; নেমে যাওয়া।
(২) (ভূমি) ধসে যাওয়া, বসে/নেমে যাওয়া।
(৩) (ভবন) মাটিতে বসে যাওয়া।
(৪) (বায়ু, চিত্তবেগ ইত্যাদি) শান্ত/প্রশমিত হওয়া; পড়ে যাওয়া।
(৫) (হাস্যরসাত্মক) (ব্যক্তি) ধীরে ধীরে নিচে নামা; প্রতিষ্ঠিত/রোপিত হওয়া: subside into a chair.

Other Forms: Subsidence [সাব্‌সাইডন্‌স্‌] (noun) [countable noun, uncountable noun] অধোগমন; অবনমন; অধোগতি; অধঃপতন।

Example Sentence: 
1. Everyone should wait a few minutes until the storm subsides.
2. The mud subsides when the waters become calm. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২) Which of the following is the synonym of 'Desultory'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Desultory (adjective)

English Meaning: Without a clear plan or purpose and showing little effort or interest.
Bangla Meaning: উদ্দেশ্যহীন; অসংলগ্ন; এলোমেলো; বিক্ষিপ্ত: desultory reading.

Synonyms: Random (এলোমেলো), Aimless (লক্ষ্যহীন), Inconsistent (সামঞ্জস্যহীন), Purposeless (উদ্দেশ্যহীন), Superfluous (অনাবশ্যকীয়, গুরুত্বহীন)। 
Antonyms: Keen (তীব্র; গভীর), Systematic (প্রণালিবদ্ধ; সুশৃঙ্খল), Lasting (দীর্ঘস্থায়ী), Enthusiastic (উদ্যমী), Passionate (আবেগী)। 

Other Forms: 
- Desultorily (adverb); - Desultoriness (noun).

Example Sentence: 
1. She made a desultory attempt at conversation.
2. The desultory conversation characteristic of cocktail parties.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৩) Antonym of ‘Supposition’-
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Supposition (noun)

Synonyms: Suspicion (সন্দেহ; সংশয়; অবিশ্বাস), Belief (বিশ্বাস; আস্থা), Assumption (অনুমান), Hypothesis (পূর্বানুমান), Impression (প্রভাব)। 
Antonyms: Fact (প্রকৃত ঘটনা), Certainty (নিশ্চয়তা), Assurance (আত্মপ্রত্যয়; আত্মবিশ্বাস), Confidence (আত্মবিশ্বাস), Reality(বাস্তবতা)।

English Meaning: An idea that something may be true, although it is not certain.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) [uncountable noun] অনুমান, কল্পনা।
(২) [countable noun] অনুমান, আন্দাজ, আঁচ।
on this supposition; on the supposition that ...যদি ধরে নেওয়া যায় যে…।
Other Forms: Suppositional (adjective).

Example Sentence: 
1.They were working on the supposition that his death was murder.
2. Every society is built upon certain suppositions.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৪) What is the noun form of 'Gullible'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Gullible (adjective)

English Meaning: Easily deceived or tricked, and too willing to believe everything that other people say.
Bangla Meaning: সহজে প্রতারণাযোগ্য।

Other Forms: - Gullibility [গালাবিলাটি] (noun)
- Gull (verb transitive) ধোঁকা দেওয়া, প্রতারণা করা।
- Gull (noun) সামুদ্রিক পাখিবিশেষ; শঙ্খচিল।
- Gullibly (Adverb)

Example Sentence: 
1. After all, there are so many gullible people who believe whatever they read from internet!
2. At that early age she had been gullible and in love.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৫) "Every dog has its _____ ." Fill the proverb with the appropriate word.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
পুরো proverb হবে- Every dog has its day.
অর্থ: সবার জীবনেরই সৌভাগ্য বা সাফল্যের একটা সময় আসে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৬) What kind of parts of speech is 'Precursor'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Precursor (noun)
[Uncountable noun]

English Meaning: Something that comes before another and may lead to it or influence its development.
Bangla Meaning: (আনুষ্ঠানিক) ভবিষ্যতের ইঙ্গিতস্বরূপ ব্যক্তি বা বস্তু; অগ্রদূত; পূর্বলক্ষণ।

Other Forms: Precursory (adjective) পূর্বসূচক; অগ্রসূচক।

Example Sentence: 
1. What appeals to me is that it's a precursor of Pinter and a follower of Coward.
2. It was a precursor to the phone we all use today. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৭) The bengali meaning of the phrase 'Come round'-
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Come round

English Meaning: recover consciousness.
Bangla Meaning: আরোগ্য লাভ করা

Ex. Sentence: The patients soon come round.
Bangla Meaning: রোগীরা খুব দ্রুত আরোগ্য লাভ করলো।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৮) Find the correct spelling.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Incongruity (noun)
[uncountable noun]

English Meaning: The fact that something is incongruous.
Bangla Meaning: অসামঞ্জস্য; অসম্বদ্ধতা; অসঙ্গতি;
[countable noun] (plural incongruous ties) অসমঞ্জস্য/সামঞ্জস্যহীন কোনোকিছু।

Other Forms: - Incongruous (adjective) (with) অসমঞ্জস্য; সামঞ্জস্যহীন; সঙ্গতিবিহীন।
- Incongruously (adverb) অসমঞ্জস্যরূপৈ ইত্যাদি।

Example Sentence: 
1. The incongruity of his fleshy face and skinny body disturbed her.
2. What could come of such a collocation of names but a life of incongruity and absurdity!

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৯) What is the meaning of the word 'Intractable'?
Vocabulary Booster.option1: ক) Very easy task or work.
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ) Something very interesting to do.
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) Difficult or impossible to manage.
Vocabulary Booster.option4: ঘ) Posible ways to do the work.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Intractable (adjective)

English Meaning: Difficult or impossible to manage or control.
Bangla Meaning: সহজে নিয়ন্ত্রণ বা বশ করা যায় না এমন; দুরন্ত; দুর্দান্ত; দুঃশাসন; দুর্দম; দুর্ধর্ষ।

Other Forms: Intractability (noun) দুর্দান্ততা।

Example Sentence: 
1. Spinal cord stimulators are also used in the treatment of intractable pain.
2. Radicalization is one of the most intractable issues of our era.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১০) What is the adjective form of the word 'Supposition'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Supposition (noun)

Synonyms: Suspicion (সন্দেহ; সংশয়; অবিশ্বাস), Belief (বিশ্বাস; আস্থা), Assumption (অনুমান), Hypothesis (পূর্বানুমান), Impression (প্রভাব)। 
Antonyms: Fact (প্রকৃত ঘটনা), Certainty (নিশ্চয়তা), Assurance (আত্মপ্রত্যয়; আত্মবিশ্বাস), Confidence (আত্মবিশ্বাস), Reality(বাস্তবতা)।

English Meaning: An idea that something may be true, although it is not certain.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) [uncountable noun] অনুমান, কল্পনা।
(২) [countable noun] অনুমান, আন্দাজ, আঁচ।
on this supposition; on the supposition that ...যদি ধরে নেওয়া যায় যে…।

Other Forms: Suppositional (adjective).

Example Sentence: 
1.They were working on the supposition that his death was murder.
2. Every society is built upon certain suppositions.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১১) The english meaning of the proverb- "চাচা আপন প্রাণ বাঁচা।"
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) Every shoe fits not every foot.
Vocabulary Booster.option4: ঘ) Too much cunning overreaches itself.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
The proverb- Every man is for himself / Physicians heal thyself.
meaning: চাচা আপন প্রাণ বাঁচা।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১২) What kind of parts of speech is 'Abeyant'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Abeyance (noun)
[Uncountable noun]

English Meaning:  A state of not happening or being used at present.
Bangla Meaning: (আনুষ্ঠানিক) স্থগিতাবস্থা; সাময়িক নিষ্ক্রিয়াবস্থা; মুলতবি অবস্থা।
fall/go into abeyance (আইন সম্বন্ধীয়) (কোনো আইন, প্রথা, নিয়ম ইত্যাদির ক্ষেত্রে) স্থগিত বা মুলতবি হওয়া; অপ্রচলিত/অচল হয়ে যাওয়া।

Other Forms: Abeyant (adjective).

Example Sentence: 
1. The project is being held in abeyance until agreement is reached on funding it.
2. The spokesman confirmed that there was an outstanding planning appeal which, at present, was held in abeyance.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৩) "She disparaged her student's efforts" here the word 'disparage' means––
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Disparage (verb transitive)

English Meaning: To criticize someone or something in a way that shows a lack of respect.
Bangla Meaning: অবমূল্যায়ন করা; অবজ্ঞা করা; হীনতর কোনো কিছুর সঙ্গে তুলনাসহ অসম্মান করা।

Other Forms: Disparagement (noun) disparaging (adjective) অপমানজনক; মর্যাদাহানিকর।

Example Sentence: 
1. That is not in any way to disparage his two competitors.
2. She disparaged her student's efforts.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৪) "Cock and ____ story" Fill the idiom with the appropriate word.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Cock and bull story

English Meaning: an implausible story used as an explanation or excuse.
Bangla Meaning: আষাঢ়ে গল্প / আজগুবি গল্প

Ex. Sentence: Nobody believes this cock and bull story about the sacking incident
Bangla Meaning: কেউই বরখাস্তের ঘটনা নিয়ে আষাঢ়ে গল্প বিশ্বাস করে না

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৫) What is the noun form of the word 'Disparage'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Disparage (verb transitive)

English Meaning: To criticize someone or something in a way that shows a lack of respect.
Bangla Meaning: অবমূল্যায়ন করা; অবজ্ঞা করা; হীনতর কোনো কিছুর সঙ্গে তুলনাসহ অসম্মান করা।

Other Forms: Disparagement (noun) disparaging (adjective) অপমানজনক; মর্যাদাহানিকর।

Example Sentence: 
1. That is not in any way to disparage his two competitors.
2. She disparaged her student's efforts.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৬) What is the antonym of 'Analogous'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Analogous (adjective)

English Meaning: Having similar features to another thing and therefore able to be compared with it.
Bangla Meaning: (with) অনুরূপ; সদৃশ: They are analogous with each other.

Synonyms: Parallel (সমান্তরাল), Similar (অনুরূপ), Comparable (তুলনীয়; তুল্য; সমতুল), Correspondent (অনুরূপ), Duplicate (সদৃশ), Collimate (সমান্তরাল)।
Antonyms: Dissimilar (অসদৃশ; বিসদৃশ; ভিন্ন), Unrelated (অসম্পর্কিত), Misrelated (অসম্পর্কিত), Disagreeing (দ্বিমত পোষণ সূচক), Differing (ভিন্ন)। 

Other Forms: Analogously (adverb).

Example Sentence: 
1. The emergency vehicle for the International Space Station is analogous to a lifeboat.
2. The wings of a bee and those of a hummingbird are analogous.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৭) The correct spelling is –
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Intransigence
(noun)

Synonyms: Obstinacy (একগুঁয়েমি; জেদ), Stubbornness (জেদীতা), Doggedness (খোট), Perseverance (উদ্যম), Tenacity (দৃঢ়তা)।
Antonyms: Acceptance (গ্রহণ; স্বীকার), Compliance (সম্মতি দেওয়া), Flexibility (নমনীয়তা), Tractability (সহজতা), Adoption (খাপ খাইয়ে নেওয়া)। 

English Meaning: The quality of refusing to change your opinions or behaviour.
Bangla Meaning: আপসহীন মনোভাব; অনমনীয়তা।

Other Forms: Intransigent [ইন্‌ট্রান্‌সিজান্‌ট্] (adjective) (আনুষ্ঠানিক) (বিশেষত রাজনীতিতে) আপসহীন; অনমনীয়।

Example Sentence: 
1. Officials yesterday blamed council intransigence for the failure to reach a deal.
2. An intransigent conservative opposed to every liberal tendency. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৮) "Stop believing in fallacious reasoning." here the word 'Fallacious' means----
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ) Based on a mistaken belief
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) The news which spread quickly
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Fallacious (adjective)

English Meaning: Based on a mistaken belief.
Bangla Meaning: বিভ্রান্তিকর; ভ্রান্তিমূলক।

Other Forms: Fallacy (noun) (fallacies)
(১) [countable noun] ভুল বা মিথ্যা বিশ্বাস।
(২) [uncountable noun] মিথ্যা যুক্তি; হেত্বাভাস।

Example Sentence: 
1. If you stop to think about it, this argument is totally fallacious.
2. Stop believing in fallacious reasoning.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৯) Which of the following is not the synonym of 'Burgeon'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Burgeon (verb intransitive)

Synonyms: Grow rapidly (দ্রুত বৃদ্ধি), Proliferate (দ্রুত বেড়ে ওঠা), Thrive (বর্ধিত হওয়া), Multiply (বহুগুণে বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া), Flourish (বিকশিত হওয়া)। 
Antonyms: Shrink (সংকুচিত হওয়া বা করা; খাপা; খাটো হওয়া), Decline (ক্ষয়প্রাপ্ত হওয়া), Fade (মলিন হয়ে যাওয়া), Languish (নেতিয়ো যাওয়া বা ঝিমিয়ে পড়া), Reject (প্রত্যাখান করা)। 

English Meaning: To develop or grow quickly.
Bangla Meaning: (কাব্যিক) পল্লবিত হওয়া; অঙকুরিত হওয়া।
(লাক্ষণিক) দ্রুত বেড়ে ওঠা; দ্রুত বিকশিত হওয়া।

Example Sentence: 
1. Central Park is rife with robins, great with grackles, and burgeoning with blue jays.
2. The burgeoning population could be a great problem if we fail to empower them with proper skills. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২০) "Every ___ must pay his skin to the furrier." - Fill the idiom with the appropriate word.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
পুরো proverb হবে- Every fox must pay his skin to the furrier / Too much cunning overreaches itself.
অর্থ: অতি চালাকের গলায় দড়ি।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২১) What is the Bengali meaning of the word 'Equanimity'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Equanimity:
(noun)
English Meaning: calmness and composure, especially in a difficult situation.
Bangla Meaning: মনমেজাজের প্রশান্তি।

অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর না থাকায় উত্তর বাতিল করা হয়েছে।
প্রশ্নে Desultory থাকলে উত্তর "উদ্দেশ্যহীন" হতো।
=====================

Desultory:
(adjective)

English Meaning: Without a clear plan or purpose and showing little effort or interest.
Bangla Meaning: উদ্দেশ্যহীন; অসংলগ্ন; এলোমেলো; বিক্ষিপ্ত: desultory reading.

Other Forms: 
- Desultorily (adverb); - Desultoriness (noun).

Example Sentence: 
1. She made a desultory attempt at conversation.
2. The desultory conversation characteristic of cocktail parties.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২২) The adjective form of the word 'Plethora'
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Plethora (noun)

English Meaning: A very large amount of something, especially a larger amount than you need, want, or can deal with.
Bangla Meaning: (আনুষ্ঠানিক) (১) অতিপ্রাচুর্য; আতিশয্য।
(২) (চিকিৎসাশাস্ত্র) রক্তে লালকণিকার আধিক্যজনিত রোগ; রক্তসিক্ত।

Other Forms: Plethoric (adjective).

Example Sentence: 
1. The plethora of regulations is both contradictory and confusing.
2. The Plethora of details about anything does not bring any good. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২৩) The meaning of 'Catch a tartar' is---
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ) to get rid of someone
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) a person used by another as a tool / dupe.
Vocabulary Booster.option4: ঘ) to oppose someone too strong for one
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Catch a tartar

English Meaning: to attack or oppose someone too strong for one.
Bangla Meaning: শক্ত প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর পাল্লায় পরা

Ex. Sentence: It looks like we caught a Tartar when we tried to muscle their store out of the area.
Bangla Meaning: যখন আমরা জোর করে তাদের দোকান হটিয়ে দিতে চেয়েছিলাম তখন বুঝেছি যে আমরা খুব শক্ত লোকের পাল্লায় পরেছি।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২৪) What is the synonym of 'Dogmatic'?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Dogmatic (adjective)

Synonyms: Assertive (দৃঢ়প্রত্যয়ী), Emphatic (জোরালো), Adamant (অনমনীয়; দৃঢ়সংকল্প; অনড়), Self-asserting (আত্মবিশ্বাসী), Emphatic (জোরদার)।
Antonyms: Low-key (নিয়ন্ত্রিত রীতি), Tentative (আপাতত স্থিরীকৃত), Open-minded (মুক্তমনা), Subdued (নরম বা প্রশমিত), Provisional (অস্থায়ী)। 

English Meaning:  Of a person or a group) strongly expressing your beliefs as if they were facts.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) (ব্যক্তি) মূল্যহীন বা গোঁড়া মতবাদ প্রকাশ করে এমন। 
(২) (উক্তি) যুক্তি বা তথ্যনির্ভর নয় এমন মতবাদ বা বিশ্বাস।

Other Forms: 
- Dogmatically (adverb) 
- Dogma (noun) 
- Dogmatize (verb) 

Example Sentence: 
1. The evidence on both sides rather took the form of dogmatic assertions.
2. The dogmatic position taken by both parties shows how desperate they are. 

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২৫) The word 'Adulterate' means -
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Adulterate (verb transitive)

English Meaning: To make something weaker or of worse quality by adding something else to it.
Bangla Meaning: ভেজাল দেওয়া/মেশানো; দূষিত/অপকৃষ্ট/হীনমূল্য করা।

Other Forms: 
- Adulterant (noun) ভেজাল, খাদ।
- Adulteration (noun) ভেজাল, অপমিশ্রণ, মিশাল।

Example Sentence: 
1. Saffron is very expensive, and is often adulterated with other plants.
2. When you cook with rotten vegetables, it will adulterate other items as well.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
